================================================================
Line comments are named nodes
================================================================

// leading
fun f() {
    // inside
}

----

(source_file
  (line_comment)
  (function_declaration
    (simple_identifier)
    (function_value_parameters)
    (function_body
      (block
        (line_comment)))))

================================================================
KDoc is distinguished from a plain block comment
================================================================

/** documentation */
/* plain */
/**/
fun f() {}

----

(source_file
  (kdoc)
  (block_comment)
  (block_comment)
  (function_declaration
    (simple_identifier)
    (function_value_parameters)
    (function_body
      (block))))

================================================================
Block comments nest
================================================================

/* outer /* inner */ still outer */
fun f() {}

----

(source_file
  (block_comment)
  (function_declaration
    (simple_identifier)
    (function_value_parameters)
    (function_body
      (block))))

================================================================
A comment between the links of a call chain
================================================================

fun f() {
    val i = Builder()
        .a(t)
        // a comment where the chain continues
        .b(u)
}

----

(source_file
  (function_declaration
    (simple_identifier)
    (function_value_parameters)
    (function_body
      (block
        (statements
          (property_declaration
            (variable_declaration
              (simple_identifier))
            (postfix_expression
              (postfix_expression
                (postfix_expression
                  (postfix_expression
                    (postfix_expression
                      (simple_identifier)
                      (postfix_unary_suffix
                        (call_suffix
                          (value_arguments))))
                    (postfix_unary_suffix
                      (navigation_suffix
                        (member_access_operator)
                        (simple_identifier))))
                  (postfix_unary_suffix
                    (call_suffix
                      (value_arguments
                        (value_argument
                          (simple_identifier))))))
                (line_comment)
                (postfix_unary_suffix
                  (navigation_suffix
                    (member_access_operator)
                    (simple_identifier))))
              (postfix_unary_suffix
                (call_suffix
                  (value_arguments
                    (value_argument
                      (simple_identifier))))))))))))

================================================================
A URL inside a string is not a comment
================================================================

val u = "https://example.com/x"

----

(source_file
  (property_declaration
    (variable_declaration
      (simple_identifier))
    (string_literal
      (line_string_literal))))
